end.summary: Practised common non-metals and their solid, liquid or gas forms.
end.parentNote: Pari practised identifying oxygen, nitrogen, sulphur and iodine, and connected nitrogen with plant growth, fertilisers, oxygen with breathing, and iodine with iodised salt. They also recalled that oxygen makes up about 21% of air and explained uses using everyday examples. Some state-of-matter names were still being recalled; this was not corrected after the last mention. At home, ask Pari to sort the listed non-metals into solid, liquid and gas groups and say one use for each.
